title: Learning Intelligence Platform 2.0
subtitle: End-to-End Media Processing Orchestrator & Local AI
summary: Local CLI platform for transcription (Whisper), visual analysis (FFmpeg keyframes/OCR), and intelligent synthesis (Ollama deepseek-r1) of video lectures with RAG and vector search.
overview: Local CLI-orchestrated platform that transforms static video courses into a structured, searchable knowledge base via a robust 8-stage pipeline. Extracts audio and visual keyframes, generates precise timestamped transcriptions, and performs cognitive synthesis using local LLMs (Ollama / deepseek-r1). Produces Markdown dossiers and populates relational and vector databases powering AI Tutor (RRF hybrid search) and AI Copilot.
roleDescription: AI Solutions Architect & Tech Lead — Designed V2 architecture, data pipeline engineering, and AI governance.
responsibilities: Domain modeling using Pydantic and system evolution formalization across 15 Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
Engineered the End-to-End orchestrator managing ingestion, transcription, visual analysis, and hierarchical synthesis (Lesson ➔ Module ➔ Course).
Implemented RAG engine featuring hybrid search (textual + semantic with Reciprocal Rank Fusion) and native integration with local models (Ollama / deepseek-r1).
Instituted Jidoka (Andon Cord) principles and created IsolationAuditorV5 for AI hallucination containment.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Unifying diverse engines (Computer Vision, Audio, LLM) into a fault-tolerant pipeline without forfeiting hours of neural network computations on heavy video batches.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented Idempotency design patterns with intelligent caching (SKIPPED status for pre-processed assets) yielding 0.05s cache bypass and seamless hierarchical synthesis.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Migrating legacy V1 codebase while enforcing strict typing and decoupling legacy debt.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Created a structured Pydantic compatibility layer, isolating legacy structures from the clean domain core.

futureEvolution: Development of a Web or Desktop GUI (Electron/Tauri) over the existing CLI.
Native ingestion and real-time transcription support for live video streams (RTMP).
